steps.arg:
"ffmpeg -y -v error -i song.m4a -ac 1 -ar 16000 work/song.wav && python3 - <<'PY'
import wave, numpy as np, json
p='work/song.wav'
with wave.open(p,'rb') as w:
 sr=w.getframerate(); x=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype=np.int16).astype(np.float32)/32768
hop=int(sr*.02); win=int(sr*.08)
rms=[]; zcr=[]
for i in range(0,len(x)-win,hop):
 f=x[i:i+win]; rms.append(float(np.sqrt(np.mean(f*f)))); zcr.append(float(np.mean(f[:-1]*f[1:]<0)))
r=np.array(rms); peaks=[]
for i in range(2,len(r)-2):
 if r[i]>r[i-1] and r[i]>=r[i+1] and r[i]>np.percentile(r,70): peaks.append(round(i*.02,2))
# keep spaced onset candidates
kept=[]
for t in peaks:
 if not kept or t-kept[-1]>.18: kept.append(t)
json.dump({'sr':sr,'rms20ms':rms,'zcr20ms':zcr,'onsets':kept},open('work/audio_analysis.json','w'))
print('duration',len(x)/sr,'rms range',r.min(),r.max(),'onsets',kept[:80])
PY"
